label: Bible Study
prompt: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of _____ that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
verse: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
note: Faith tested like gold in a furnace — and worth far more than gold.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: A _____ heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verse: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
note: A merry heart shows up on the face — Solomon's version of 'smiles are contagious.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And a certain man drew a bow at a _____, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verse: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
note: A soldier drew his bow 'at a venture' — at random — and the disguised king of Israel couldn't hide from it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I drew them with _____ of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verse: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
note: God led Israel like a father teaching a toddler to walk — with human ropes, with bands of love.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Lord, now _____ thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
verse: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
note: Old Simeon, holding the baby Jesus in the temple: now 'lettest thou thy servant depart in peace.'
